description: This file implements the HibernatePersonDAO class, which provides Hibernate-specific database operations for the Person entity in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying Person and related entities such as Relationships, PersonAttributes, and PersonNames, often with complex criteria and search capabilities.

classes.name: HibernatePersonDAO
classes.description: A Hibernate-based implementation of the PersonDAO interface, managing persistence and search operations for Person entities and related associations.

methods.name: getSimilarPeople
methods.description: Performs a fuzzy search for persons based on a name string, splitting into parts and executing soundex-based queries depending on the number of components.

methods.name: getPeople
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Person entities matching a search string and optional filters for dead or voided status using search session queries.

methods.name: savePerson
methods.description: Saves or updates a Person entity within the Hibernate session.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person and all associated data (addresses, attributes, names) to maintain referential integrity.

methods.name: getPersonByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Person entity based on UUID using Hibernate utility methods.
